page.overview:
Who is Miki Takanashi?

Compared to his peers, Takanashi is by far the youngest. He has noticeably round eyes and slanted eyebrows.

Takanashi is the sole member of the Japanese politician board who outwardly protests against the morality and ethics regarding Public Safety’s plan. He’s also the only member concerned for the welfare of children, regardless if they’re Japanese-born citizens or not.

At some point in time, Miki Takanashi became the Minister of Economy of Japan.

Miki Takanashi is one of the Japanese Government Officials who had a meeting in order to discuss the potential of erasing the Aging Devil from existence and its affects on the people of Japan.
